description: IndexNow for PHP: core client plus Symfony, Laravel, Yii2 and Doctrine adapters. Declare public pages on the model with #[IndexNow], submissions leave after the transaction commits, debounced and batched; a sitemap reader; check/explain commands.
rules: Read the README of the package for the framework in use (packages/symfony-bundle, packages/laravel, packages/yii2); packages/core is the plain-PHP client the adapters build on.

Declare public pages on the model with repeatable #[IndexNow] attributes from IndexNowKit\Attribute; register the hook with the adapter's mechanism (Doctrine listener, the IndexNowable trait, the IndexNowBehavior behavior).
dispatch: auto exists in Symfony and Yii2, not in Laravel (queue | sync | none).
Locales come from router.locales (Laravel), router.languages (Yii2) or framework.enabled_locales (Symfony).
url: names an accessor that returns the URL; urls: is a list of literal URLs. A string in when: is a truthy accessor; compare a status with IndexNowKit\Attribute\Param\Equals.

Manual submission: submitEntity() (Symfony), submitModel() (Laravel), submitRecord() (Yii2); bulk queries fire no hooks, submit afterwards with the submit-entity / submit-model / submit-record command.
Laravel has two classes named IndexNowKit: the facade IndexNowKit\Laravel\Facades\IndexNowKit and the core service IndexNowKit\IndexNowKit.

Verify with the check command (bin/console indexnow:check, php artisan indexnow:check, php yii indexnow/check); it exits 1 on any error and fails outside production when a key is configured and dry_run is unset.
IndexNow is a notification, not indexing; Google does not participate.
